A calm second pair of eyes that helps you spot scam messages and calls before they cost you.
Nothing is read until you say so
Every source starts switched off. You choose what Sentinel may look at, and you can turn it off at any time.
Sensitive details are hidden on your phone
OTPs, card numbers and account numbers are masked on your phone before anything is sent anywhere.
One button in Settings removes your account and all your data from Sentinel and from this phone.
You can change this later in Settings.
Turn on only what you are comfortable with. Tap “What we read” to see exactly what is and is not used.
Allow notifications so Sentinel can warn you right away about high-risk and critical alerts.
SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, email, UPI and bank app notifications
Number, time and duration only. No audio.
Only what you choose to send for a check
Always on, you stay in control
Here is exactly what this source uses.
Notifications from the watched apps only: SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, Gmail, Outlook, UPI and bank apps
Who sent it and when. A phone number or SMS sender ID is sent as is; the name of a saved contact is replaced on your phone by a code and never leaves it
The notification text, with OTPs, card, account, Aadhaar and PAN numbers hidden on your phone first
Your chat history or anything you did not receive as a notification
Your photos, files or your contact list (we only check yes or no whether a sender is saved)
Anything before you turn this on, or after you turn it off

Android will first ask to check your contacts (only to tell whether a sender is saved; names never leave your phone), then open the Notification access screen. Switch Sentinel on there, then come back.
The number, time, duration and direction (incoming, outgoing, missed) of calls
Whether the number is saved in your contacts
What you or the caller say
Your contact list or contact names

Family members can be told when something critical happens. They only ever see a short headline, never your messages.
Create a code and give it to a family member you trust. They enter it in their Sentinel app.
I agree to share critical alert headlines
A guardian sees only a short headline when a critical alert happens. Never the message, numbers, links or your name.
Turn on the switch above to create a code.

Heads-up with vibration for active scams
A pure black background saves power on OLED screens.
Solid backgrounds instead of glass. Easier to read and uses less battery.
A %1$s alert arrived today. Open it to see what to do.
Replays a three-day scam story with sample messages so you can see how Sentinel reacts.
Message text is masked on your phone before it is sent. Names of your contacts never leave your phone.

From the watched apps: the notification text, masked on your phone first (OTPs, card, account, Aadhaar and PAN numbers hidden), the sender number or SMS sender ID (a saved contact\'s name is replaced by a code), the time and a risk score. For calls: the number, time, duration and direction. Plus anything you choose to check.
The original message text, the names in your contacts, notifications of all other apps, photos, files and any call audio (which is never recorded).
Until you delete it. “Delete my data” removes your account and everything linked to it from Sentinel right away.
This removes your Sentinel account, alerts, consents and family links from our servers and from this phone. It cannot be undone.
Watch a three-day scam unfold: a courier SMS, an unknown call, then a WhatsApp payment demand. See how Sentinel connects the dots.
These are sample messages. They are added to your account with past dates, and running the demo again will not duplicate them.
Nothing worth an alert on its own
Running it again is safe: the same events are recognised as duplicates.
Notifications are not being read. Turn off Pause protection in Settings to resume.
Android has turned off Sentinel\'s notification access, so nothing is being checked.
Turn on the Notifications source to check SMS, WhatsApp and bank alerts as they arrive.
Counts only. Message text is masked on your phone before it is queued or sent, and is never kept after sending.
Sentinel reads notifications from these apps only. All other apps are ignored.
None of the supported apps are installed.
%1$d supported apps in total (SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, email, UPI and bank apps).
Messages waiting to be sent will be deleted from this phone and will not be checked.
Restricted: Android may stop Sentinel in the background
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. Allowing Sentinel keeps checks running; it uses very little battery because it only wakes when a watched app posts a notification.
